versions.subject: feat: updates and fixes
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\powershell.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
        - 'PowerShell.EXE'
        - 'pwsh.dll'
selection_cmdlet:
    CommandLine|contains: 'Add-WindowsCapability'
selection_capa:
    CommandLine|contains: 'OpenSSH.' # For both "OpenSSH.Server" and "OpenSSH.Client"
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe") OR OriginalFileName IN ("PowerShell.EXE", "pwsh.dll") CommandLine="*Add-WindowsCapability*" CommandLine="*OpenSSH.*"
